name: FilterChip
description: The filter in effect, beside the filter button that chose it: an `info-soft` chip as high as the button, with an optional 14px icon, a `FilterChipLabel` and a `FilterChipRemove` × that resets the filter.

name: FilterChipLabel
description: The name of the active filter. It truncates when the row has no room.

name: FilterChipRemove
description: The × that resets the filter to its default. Shows an X unless given children.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: What the × does, said in words: the chip shows only a glyph. Name the result, such as "Clear Filter" or "Show All".

props.name: focusableWhenDisabled
props.description: Whether the button should be focusable when disabled.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
